summary: academic-research-skills commits held-out measurement suites with preregistrations, run records and raw outputs: on seeded-defect manuscripts the reviewer panel reached recall 1.00 on both defective fixtures with 0 clean-control false findings while severity agreement fell from 0.672 to 0.607 (and from 0.663 to 0.536 after the #581 batch), and a preregistered audit put the panel's false-claim rate between 12/805 (1.5%) and 104/805 (12.9%). A guard prompt lowered judged claim-strength drift from 7/16 to 1/16 without eliminating it, the Wording-Pattern Advisory's held-out miss rate went from 0.375/0.344 to 0.094 with 0/16 false fires (judge protocol, no runner script), and the gpt-5.6-sol citation-verifier bakeoff recorded recall 0.90 vs 0.80 on 10 non-existent references (p95 latency 25.0 s vs 49.6 s) from committed receipts and an offline scorer. Smaller checks are reported as session counts, including a routing fix that passed 3 of 6 sessions and did not meet its preregistered acceptance rule; the per-mode token and cost table in docs/PERFORMANCE.md is an estimate measured on Opus 4.x, and several release notes mark prompt-level changes as unmeasured.
